name: C#
description: A small C# inventory library with a dependency-free test runner. Five tasks: add a member, a coordinated two-place edit, a bug fix, a byte-exact BOM and CRLF edit, and tests that must kill mutants.

toolchain.name: dotnet
toolchain.hint: .NET SDK 8 or later on the Admiral host's PATH

toolchain.name: git
toolchain.hint: git on the Admiral host's PATH

tasks.title: Add a member to an existing class
tasks.prompt: In src/Inventory/Item.cs add a read-only property `public decimal TotalValue` that returns UnitPrice times Quantity. Give it an XML doc comment like the other members. Keep the build and the existing tests passing (`dotnet build Inventory.sln`, `dotnet run --project tests/Inventory.Tests`).

tasks.title: Coordinated two-place edit: write a test method and register it
tasks.prompt: Add a test method `Stock_Remove_MoreThanAvailable_Throws` to tests/Inventory.Tests/StockTests.cs. It adds an item with 2 units and checks that removing 3 units throws InvalidOperationException. A test only runs when it is registered, so also register it in tests/Inventory.Tests/TestRegistry.cs. `dotnet run --project tests/Inventory.Tests` must pass.

tasks.title: Fix a bug from a failing test
tasks.prompt: The test PriceCalculator_ApplyDiscount_TenPercent fails (`dotnet run --project tests/Inventory.Tests`). Find and fix the bug in the library code. Do not change or remove the tests.

tasks.title: Edit a file with a UTF-8 BOM and CRLF line endings
tasks.prompt: In src/Inventory/LegacyCodes.cs change MaxCodeLength from 8 to 12. Change nothing else. The file is UTF-8 with a byte order mark and CRLF line endings; keep both exactly as they are.

tasks.title: Write tests for an untested method, including negative paths
tasks.prompt: TextUtil.Truncate in src/Inventory/TextUtil.cs has no tests. Write tests for it in a new file tests/Inventory.Tests/TextUtilTests.cs and register each one in tests/Inventory.Tests/TestRegistry.cs. Cover the normal cases, the boundary where the value is exactly maxLength, and the negative paths (null value, maxLength below 3). Do not change src/. `dotnet run --project tests/Inventory.Tests` must pass.
